title: 12 Best Hand-Knotted Silk Carpet Weaving Workshops in Bukhara
description: Discover Bukhara's finest family workshops where master weavers create exquisite hand-knotted silk carpets, preserving centuries-old Bukharan geometric patterns.

places.name: Bukhara Silk Carpet Workshop (Near Lyab-i Hauz)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Observe the precise hand-knotting technique and ask about the significance of specific Bukharan patterns like 'Bukhara Gul'.

places.name: Siyavush Textile (Gijduvan Style & Bukhara Patterns)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for carpets that blend Bukharan geometric motifs with the rich color palettes often seen in Gijduvan textiles.

places.name: Tim Abdullakhan Local Family Workshop
places.priceRange: Free to observe, Guided explanation: 20,000-40,000 UZS ($1.60-$3.20) per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Inquire about the natural dyes used for their wool carpets and the meaning behind the more rustic, traditional motifs.

places.name: Nodir Devonbegi Madrasah Carpet Gallery & Workshop
places.priceRange: Free to observe, Guided tour (part of Madrasah visit): 30,000 UZS ($2.40) per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Focus on the precision involved in replicating complex geometric patterns, often specific to madrasah designs.

places.name: Bukhara Carpet & Embroidery Center
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask about the different types of knots (e.g., symmetrical Ghiordes knot) and their impact on carpet durability and texture.

places.name: Magoki Attori Mosque Area Workshops
places.priceRange: Free to observe, Guided explanation: 25,000-45,000 UZS ($2.00-$3.60) per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Seek out carpets featuring motifs that predate the Islamic era, showing Bukhara's diverse historical layers.

places.name: Old City Weavers' Guild Workshop
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Observe the interactions between master and apprentice, noting how techniques are passed down through generations.

places.name: Abdullo Carpet Gallery & Workshop
places.priceRange: Free to observe, Guided explanation: 25,000-45,000 UZS ($2.00-$3.60) per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Inquire about the family's specific design signatures or patterns that have been passed down through their lineage.

places.name: Mirzo Ulugbek Madrasah Area Workshops
places.priceRange: Free to observe, Guided explanation: 20,000-40,000 UZS ($1.60-$3.20) per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Appreciate the silence and focus of the weavers as they work, often using small tools for intricate details.

places.name: Bukhara Handicraft Center (Old Caravanserai)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Compare the different types of carpets and weaves displayed, noting the subtle differences between silk and wool or various regional styles.

places.name: Silk Road Weavers Gallery & Workshop
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask about the sourcing of their natural silk and the specific plants or minerals used for their traditional dyes.

places.priceRange: Free to observe, Donation/Small fee for explanation: 15,000-30,000 UZS ($1.20-$2.40) per person
